Thursday, June 25, 2026

HAWAIIAN MUSIC VENUES FOR WEEKLY "LIVE MUSIC" GIGS July - September 2026

 

  • MONDAY

    North Shore:

    • The Tahiti Nui Restaurant & Lounge in Hanalei presents Michael Keale from 6:30-8:30 pm

    • The Happy Talk Lounge at Hanalei Bay Resort in Princeville features Falling Down Romance from 6:00-9:00pm
    • The Sunset Lanai at Anina Hou in Kilauea features Pancho Graham 4:00-5:30 pm
    East Side:

    • The Ocean House Lounge at the Outrigger Kaua`i Beach Resort in Wailua features Channel and Sky from 6:00-8:00 pm

    •  The Na Pali Brewing Company in Kapaa features Bruddah K from 5:30-7:30
    • The Lava Lava Beach Club at the Kaua`i Shores Hotel  features Darryl Gonzales 3:00-5:00,  followed by Jonathan from 6:00-9:00 pm
    • The Kauai Inn features Sheldon Espina at 5:30 pm
    • The Crooked Surf Restaurant at the Sheraton Coconut Beach Hotel in Waipouli features Wayne and Junior Panui from 5:30-7:30 pm
    • Bangkok Happy Bowl and Thai Bistro features Kyle La Benz with hula by Nikole 6:30-8:30pm
    West Side
    • The Kokee Lodge in Kokee features Nick Castillo from 12:00-2:00pm

    TUESDAY
    North Shore:
    • The Tahiti Nui Restaurant and Lounge in Hanalei presents Makaha O Na Lani with Randy and Primrose Rego from 6:30-8:30 pm
    • The Westin Princeville Ocean Resort Villa features Kaliko Mai`i from 5:30-7:30 pm 
     • The new Gaia Restaurant (Formerly Opakapaka) in Ha`ena features Allan Thomas from 6:00-8:00 pm
    East Side:
    • The Coconut Marketplace Shopping Center (stage area) features Local Hawaiian Contemporary music at 5:00 pm
     •• The Crooked Surf Restaurant at the Sheraton Coconut Beach Hotel in Waipouli features Sean Carillo from 5:30-7:30 pm 
    • The Lava Lava Beach Club at the Kaua`i Shores Hotel features Scott K from 3:00-5:00 pm, and Tim Haggert from 6:00-9:00pm

    • The Ocean House Lounge at the Outrigger Kaua`i Beach Resort in Wailua features Alika and Pono from 6:00-8:00 pm

    • Duke’s Barefoot Bar at the Royal Sonesta Resort at Kalapaki Bay presents Loki Sasil from 4:00-6:00pm

    • Cafe Portofino next to Duke’s in Nawiliwili features Lurline Lei Fernandez from 6:00-8:00

    •  The Na Pali Brewing Company in Kapaa features John Kepa Mahi from 5:30-7:30pm
    • Hualani's Restaurant at Timber's Resort in Lihue features Sheldon Espina from 6:00-9:00 pm
    South Shore:
    • Keoki’s Paradise in the Po`ipu Shopping Village features Chico from 5:00-8:30 pm 
    • Peitro's Pizzaria in Po`ipu features  Sheldon Espina 5:30-7:30 pm
    •The Kauai Island Brewery in Ele`ele features Nick Castillo, Frank Cruz and Dave 
    parsons from 5:00-7:00pm
    • The Food Trucks at Koloa featuring Kyle LaBenz 12:00-2:00 pm 
    • The Seaview Terrace auth Grand Hyatt  in Po`ipu is featuring Kyle La Benz from 7:30-9:30 pm
    WEST SIDE:
    • The Saddle Room at the Wrangler Steakhouse in Waimea features Kahalau Leoki from 6:00-8:00 pm

    WEDNESDAY 
    North Shore:
    • The Tahiti Nui in Hanalei presents Hui Halau O Kahealani , Aunty Bev Kauanui and Haunani Kauai with the hula maidens starting at 5:30 pm
    •  The Westin Princeville Ocean Villas features Pancho Graham from 5:30-7:30pm

     • The Happy Talk Lounge at the Hanalei Bay Resort in Princeville features Makana O Na Lani with Randy and Primrose Rego from 6:00-9:00 pm

    • The Lighthouse Bistro features Chad Pa and Paul Kaimina`oau from 6:30-8:30 pm

    • The Sunset Lanai at Anina Hou in Kilauea features Kaliko Mai`i from 4:00-5:30

    • The Makai Club Art Festival at 4080 Lei O Papa Road features The Soulgood Family with Jeremy Brown Duo 1:20-2:50 pm followed by various musicians from 3-4:30 pm

     EAST SIDE

    The Ocean House Lounge at the Outrigger Kaua`i Beach Resort in Wailua features Demaine and Sky from 6:00-8:00 pm

    • The Oasis Bar and Grill at the Waipouli Resort features Adrienne Guerrero and Aaron Nakamura from 5:-7:00 pm 

    • Namaka Restaurant in Kauai Village features Ho`aka from 6:00-8:00 pm

    • There is a hula show featuring Leilani Rivera Low and Halau Hula O Leilani at 5pm at the Coconut Marketplace Shopping Center stage area 

    The Crooked Surf Restaurant at the Sheraton Coconut Beach Resort in Waipouli features Kyle LaBenz with hula from 5:30-7:30pm
    • The Na Pali Brewing Company in Kapaa features Sheldon Espina from 5:30-7:30 pm
    • Troy's Place in Lihue features Oiwi with John Kepa Mahi from 7:30-9:30 pm
    • The Lava Lava Beach Club at the Kaua`i Shores Hotel  features Loki Sasil from 6:00-9:00 pm
    South Shore:
    • Keoki’s Paradise in the Po`ipu Shopping Village features Chanel Waipualani Flores 5:00 - 7:30 pm
    • The Kaua`i Island Brewery at the Port Allen Marina features Frank Cruz from 5:00-7:00 pm
    West Side:
    • The Kokee Lodge features Nick Castillo from 1:00-3:00pm
    •  The Saddle Room at the Wrangler Steakhouse in Waimea presents Jojo (Tango) Tangalin 6:00-8:00 pm 

    THURSDAY
    North Shore: 
    • The Tahiti Nui Restaurant & Bar in Hanalei features Hui Halau O Kahealani , Aunty Bev Kauanui and Haunani Kauai with the hula maidens starting at 5:30 pm
    • The Westin Princeville Ocean Resort Villa features Michael Keale from 5:30-7:30 pm 
    • The Happy Talk Lounge at the Hanalei Bay Resort in Princeville features Kaimi Hermosura & Del Seeger from 6:00-9:00pm
    • The Sunset Lanai at Anina Hou in Kilauea features Various Musicians 4:00-5:30 pm
    East Side:

    • The Ocean House Lounge at the Outrigger Kaua`i Beach Resort in Wailua features Channel and Rieff from 6:00-8:00 pm

      • There is a Hula show featuring Leilani Rivera Low & Halua Hula O Leilani, at 12:00 pm at the Coconut Marketplace Shopping Center in Waipouli
    • The Crooked Surf Restaurant at the Sheraton Coconut Beach Resort in Waipouli features Danny DeFries from 5:50-7:30 pm
    • The Hukilau Lanai at the Kaua`i Coast Resort in Waipouli presents Dennis Chun from 5:30-8:30 pm
    • Duke's Barefoot Bar at the Royal Sonesta Resort iat Kalapaki Bay features John "Kepa" Mahi from 6:00-8:00pm

    • The Lava Lava Beach Club features Darryl Gonzales 3:00-5:00 followed by Falling Down Romance 6:00-9:00pm

    •  The Na Pali Brewing Company (Old Brickoven Pizza) in Kapaa features Sheldon Espina from 5:30-7:30

    South Shore:
    • The Kaua`i Island Brewery at the Port Allen Marina in Ele`ele features Darren from 5:00-7:00 pm
    •  The Seaview Terrace at the Grand Hyatt in Po`ipu features Tommy Tokioka from 5:00-7:00 pm
    • Keoki’s Paradise the Po`ipu Shopping Village presents Jordan from 6:00-7:00 pm in the dining room
    • The Wine Shop Tasting Room in Koloa features Bronson Aiwohi from 6:00-8:00 pm
    • The Honu Bar at the Waiohai Resort in Po`ipu  features Kyle La Benz with hula by Nikole 5:030-8:00 pm

    • Kalapaki Joe's in Po`ipu features the Kama`ainas from 6:00-8:00pm

    West Side:
    • The Saddle Room at the Wrangler Steakhouse in Waimea presents Nick Castillo from 6:00-8:00 pm 

    FRIDAY
    North Shore: .
    • The Tahiti Nui Restaurant in Hanalei features Hui Hula o Kahealani with Aunty Bev Kauanui and Haunani Kauai starting at 5:30 pm, and Karaoke in the Luau Room 7:00-10:00 pm
    • The Westin Princeville Ocean Resort Villa features Michael Keale from 5:30-7:30 pm 
    • The Happy Talk Lounge at the Hanalei Bay Resort in Princeville features Michael Ruff and Friends from 6:00-9:00pm
     East Side:There is a Hula show featuring Leilani Rivera Low & Halua Hula O Leilani, at 5:00 pm at the Coconut Marketplace Shopping Center in Waipouli 5:00-8:00pm
    • The Crooked Surf Restaurant at the Sheraton Coconut Beach Resort in Waipouli features Pono Nero from 5:30-7:30 pm
    • The Hukilau Lanai at the Kaua`i Coast resort in Waipouli presents Pancho Graham from 6:00-9:00 pm 
    •  The Na Pali Brewing Company in Kapaa features Shilo Pa from 5:30-7:30
    • The Lava Lava Beach Club at the Kaua`i Shores Hotel  features NAKZ  3:00-5:00, then John Kept Mahi from 6:00-9:00 pm

    The Ocean House Lounge at the Outrigger Kaua`i Beach Resort in Wailua features Aumakua from 6:00-8:00 pm

    • Rob's Good Time Grill features Loke Sasil from 5:00-7:00 followed by Sheldon Esona from 8:00-10:00pm
     South Shore:
    • Keoki’s Paradise in the Po`ipu Shopping Village presents Kawaiola in the dining room 5:00-7:00 and Jojo in the bar area 7:00-9:00 pm 
    • Cabana's at the Po`ipu Athletic Center features Kyle La Benz from 5:30-8:00pm
    • Merriman’s Fish House at the Kukui`ula Shopping Center in Po`ipu features music 6:00-8:00 pm
    • Kaua`i Island Brewery at Port Allen Marina in Ele`ele features Frank Cruz from 5:00-7:00 pm

    • Bankok Happy Bowl and Thai Bistro features Falling Down Romance from 6:00-8:00pm

    •  The Seaview Terrace at the Grand Hyatt in Po`ipu features music from 5:00 7:00, followed by Sheldon Espuna from 7:30--9:30 pm

    West Side:

    • The Kokee Lodge features Nick Castillo 12:30-2:30 pm
    • The Saddle Room at the Wrangler Steakhouse in Waimea presents The Triple T's from  6:00-8:00 pm 
     • Japanese Grandma's in Hanapepe features Darren Kiyotsuka from 6:00-8:00 pm

    SATURDAY 
    North Shore:
    • The Princeville Shopping Center (food court area) presents a hula show from 1:00-2:30 pm with Hui Halau O Kahealani ( Aunty Bev Kauanui and Haunani Kauai)
    • The Happy Talk Restaurant and Bar at the Hanalei Bay Resort in Princeville features Kirk Smart and Friends from 6:00-9:00pm
     East Side: The Crooked Surf Restaurant at the Sheraton Kauai`i Beach Resort in Waipouli features Lake Basil from 5:30-7:30 pm 
    • There is a Hula show,  featuring Leilani Rivera Low & Halua Hula O Leilani, at the Coconut Marketplace Shopping Center at 12:00 pm
    • The Ocean House Lounge at the Outrigger Kaua`i Beach Resort in Wailua features Tropical Groove (Haunani Maui and Linda Tan) from 6:00-8:00 pm
    •  Duke's Barefoot Bar at the Royal Sonesta Resort in Lihue features John "Kepa" Mahi from 6:00-8:00 pm
    •  The Na Pali Brewing Company in Kapaa features Norman "Kaawa" Solomon from 5:30-7:30 pm
    • The Lava Lava Beach Club at the Kauai Shores Hotel in Kapaa features Jonathan from 3:00-5:00, followed by Ron Toki 7:00-9:00pm
    South Shore:
    • Keoki’s Paradise in the Po`ipu Shopping Center presents Uncle D from 5:00-7:00 in the dining room and Troy in the Bar 7:00-9:00 pm
    • Merriman's Fish House at the Kukui`ula Shopping Center in Po`ipu features music from 5:30-7:30 pm
    • Cabana's at the Po`ipu Athletic Center in Po`ipu features music from 6:00-8:00pm
    •  The Seaview Terrace at the Grand Hyatt in Po`ipu features Falling Down Romance from 7:00-9:00 pm
     • The Honu Bar features Kyle LaBenz w/hula by Nicole from 4:00-6:00pm
    West Side:
    • The Saddle Room at the Wrangler Steakhouse in Waimea presents The Triple T's from 6:00-8:00 pm 

    SUNDAY 
    North Shore:
    • The Tahiti Nui Restaurant in Hanalei features Music starting at 6:30 pm
    • The Happy Talk Restaurant and Bar at the Hanalei Bay Resort features music from 6:00-9:00pm
     East Side:

    • The Ocean House Lounge at the Outrigger Kauai Beach Resort in Wailua features Jonathan 6:00-8:00 pm

    • The Crooked Surf Restaurant at the Sheraton Kauai`i Beach Resort in Waipouli features Darryl Gonzales from 5:30-7:30 pm
    • Timbers Bar at Hokuala features Wes Kaui & Cliff Furtado 4:00-5:30 pm
    •  The Lava Lava Beach Club at the Kauai Shores Hotel in Kapaa features Sheldon Espina or Danny De Fries (rotating) from 6:00-9:00pm
    •  The Na Pali Brewing Company  in Kapaa features John Kepa Mahi from 5:30-7:30 pm
    South Shore:
    • The Seaview Terrace at the Grand Hyatt features Kyle LaBenz from 7:30-9:30 pm
    • Keoki’s Paradise in the Po`ipu Shopping Center presents Kyle La Benz w/hula from 4:00 - 6:00 pm
    • Merriman’s Fish House at the Kukui`ula Shopping Center in Po`ipu features Auntie Kauilani Kahalekai  5:30-7:30 pm
     West Side:
    • The Kokee Lodge features Nick Castillo from 12:30-2:30pm

    • Japanese Grandmas in Hanapepe features Russel Wellington 6:00-8:00pm

    Mahalo Nui Loa, Have A Great Hawaiian Day!
